title: Maharaja
desc: Prince Kohinoor returns home after twenty years only to discover that Ranbir Singh, his parents' killer, still holds control. Subsequently, he decides to defeat him to protect his loved ones.

title: Hero Hindustani
desc: A young woman conspires with a man to fake a relationship, outsmarting her grandfather's plans to marry her off to a stranger.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Amid the ideological differences with his father Vijay, Ajay steps up to protect his family from Rajesh's, his brother-in-law's, evil intentions.

title: Lal Baadshah
desc: Lal Singh, a righteous and helpful man, clashes against Dayal Singh, a powerful personality. However, things get complicated when a hidden treasure is involved and Lal's tragic past is disclosed.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces and chart out an inspirational path of freedom against the despotic rulers.
